notes.title: Rolling back to a previous build ;_;
Hotfixes + thank you all for the initial feedback
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone that has played Rainy Season so far!

And thank you to those who were generous enough to point out bugs they encountered, and I'll continue to read any other feedback and fix them with the best of my ability. 

A quick update has been rolled out to fix these issues:

	• Fixed incorrect controls to display when interacting with objects
	• Language will randomly switch back to English
	• Camera X/Y controls are now able to be inverted



Issues with gamepad controls need further testing and investigation, so please switch to Keyboard + Mouse if you still encounter issues. 

Plans are also to polish controls (door interactions, item holding, etc) and make things a little less confusing. If you have any suggestions, please let know here or via Twitter.  (o＾▽＾o)ノ


Also a reminder that the soundtrack is available on Tunecore here: https://linkco.re/pNN8E7Xt

notes.title: Get cozy at home in upcoming Rainy Season
notes.content:
What does a family get up to when their planned trip to the amusement park is cancelled due to bad weather? Slice of life game Rainy Season wants to take a look the small things that go on while cooped up inside: chatting, poking around the clutter of the house, listening to the sound of the water. And it does sound extremely lovely. Here, take a listen in the trailer.
